text:
olga: Noticed spike in fncall validation rejects on /chat/invoke (us-west-2) around 10:03 PST. Mostly router-v2 + short-ctx-degen.
kevin: Can you share an example log?
olga: sample: id=abc123 status=validation_reject reason="output_shape_mismatch" details="expected object, got array"
ashley: Console only surfaces a generic "validation_error" tag today. No reason or variant dims.
diana: Finance also flagged some rejects being billed; billing marks tokens on receive not post-validate.
sre-bot: alert: validation_error_rate crossed 3% for /chat/invoke in us-west-2 at 17:03:20Z
kevin: Proposal: emit `validation_reason` (enum) + `validation_outcome` and `validator_version` on invoke_result events. Keep nullable; sample at 5% initially.
olga: Also add `route_variant` and `region` as indexed tags for joins. Avoid freeform strings to prevent PII leakage.
diana: We'll need a migration rule so hard rejects are excluded from billing after rollout.
nashley: UX wants a filter for reason, a legend, and one redacted failing sample per bucket. Add a soft_validate mode for telemetry-only capture.
kevin: Canary: 10% traffic on router-v2-canary for 24h with soft_validate, plus dynamic 100% capture when error_rate>2%.
console-bot: NOTE: index migration estimated +2.4GB at current sampling.
sre-bot: Ops: update alert thresholds, add sampling override, monitor cardinality.
kevin: Action items: runtime/emitter PR (kevin), canary config (olga), console index + mocks (ashley), billing rule draft (diana).
